# Load config
```{r}
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml("/home/akollot/projects/CRC1588/dataset_integration/anglemania_benchmark/scripts/config_files/LueckenTheis_config.yml")
```

# Load metrics
```{r}
# Extract relevant paths
metrics_path <- cfg$visualization$metrics_file
samplesheet_path <- cfg$samplesheet
outplot_bm <- cfg$visualization$outplot_dir_bm_visualization
# Ensure plot directories exist
if (!dir.exists(outplot_bm)) {
  dir.create(outplot_bm, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Load data
metrics <- read.delim(metrics_path)
samplesheet <- read.delim(samplesheet_path)
metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(samplesheet, by = join_by(sample == sample_name))

```

# Plot
## combined bar plot
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- metrics %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(gene_selection), y = Total))+
  geom_bar(aes(fill = gene_selection), stat = "identity")+
  facet_wrap(~integration_method+sample, ncol = 6)
p

ggsave(
  file = file.path(outplot_bm, "combined_barplot.pdf"),
  width = 20,
  height = 10,
  units = "cm")
```

## individual bar plot
```{r}
for (m in unique(metrics$integration_method)){
  for(s in unique(metrics$sample)){
    p <- metrics %>%
      filter(integration_method == m, sample == s) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(gene_selection), y = Total)) +
      geom_bar(aes(fill = gene_selection), stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      labs(x = "Gene Selection", y = "Integration Score", title = paste0("integration method:", m, "\nsample: ", s))

    print(p)
    # ggsave(
    #   file = file.path(outplot, paste0("gene_selection_vs_integration_score_", m, "_", s, ".pdf")),
    #   width = 11,
    #   height = 10,
    #   units = "cm")
  }
}
```


# plot cell type distributions per batch
* for sim2
```{r}
sim2_path <- samplesheet %>%
  filter(sample_name == "sim2_raw") %>%
  pull(file_path)
sim2 <- read_h5ad(sim2_path, to = "SingleCellExperiment")
sim2
library(SingleCellExperiment)
meta <- sim2@colData %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(meta)
meta %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .by = c(SubBatch, celltype)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = SubBatch, y = n, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack")

meta %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .by = c(SubBatch, celltype)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = celltype, y = n, fill = SubBatch)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack")

```
